name: mealvest
description: Mealvest — Vercel build orchestration root. Vercel's Node.js runtime invokes api/index.ts directly (a plain Express app export, no serverless-http adapter needed, unlike the earlier Netlify setup); this root package.json exists so `npm install`/`npm run build` at the repo root can orchestrate both server/ (installed so the function bundler can resolve its dependencies, and type-checked as a build-time safety net) and app/ (built to a static web export Vercel serves directly).

scripts.build:server-check: cd server && npm install --include=dev && npm run build
scripts.build:web: cd app && npm install --include=dev && npx expo export --platform web
scripts.build: npm run build:server-check && npm run build:web
